svg.title: map-routes
svg.desc: Seven levers organise the book. Positions and stable softmax make attention trainable at length; MQA/GQA/MLA thin each record; fixed patterns and sparse reads touch fewer records; eviction and compression keep fewer; linear, delta and test-time-learning layers replace records with a fixed state; hybrids mix both; kernels and serving move fewer bytes.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
